feeds.title: Adam Martinakis
feeds.description: The art works of digital 3d visual artist Adam Martinakis. Born in Luban, Poland in 1972, Adam Martinakis is of Polish and Greek descent. He has been working and experimenting on Computer-generated visual media. He teaches digital arts & design, graphics, interior design and ceramic design in many art institutes.

feeds.title: 3D Art
feeds.description: I am a Digital Artist, 3D Artist & Digital Compositing, and I live in London. With 3DArt, I want to create a collection and resource point of view and tutorials, useful for all CG Artists and creatives who want to have a 360 ° view on 3D, VFX and Motion Design. 3DArt aims to spread and discuss issues and artistic forms that revolve around the world of 3D and digital effects.

feeds.title: Patricia Jarandilla 3D Artist
feeds.description: I'm Patricia Jarandilla, a 3d artist who has been working as a freelancer since 2013, enjoying this job, my passion, every day. During the last years, I have worked mainly in character modelling oriented to 3D printing, digital sculpture, 3D concepts of life-size figures, mini-sculptures for 3d printing, prototype modelling and scale models. I offer my services as a professional 3D Artist to studios and professionals who need to expand permanently or occasionally their teams, who want sculptures, 3D portraits or 3d printing files.

feeds.title: ASFC 3D Design
feeds.description: ASFC 3D Design works and put-up articles on major architectural projects, software tutorials, helpful tips on composite & conceptual drawing, and more.

feeds.title: Global 3D Arts Blog
feeds.description: Global 3D Arts have been working with architects and developers for over 20 years. Our artists have over a decade of experience working with architects and developers in architectural animation, rendering, and building scale models.

feeds.title: Agora Digital Art » 3D
feeds.description: This blog section is related to three-dimensionality. Read articles on 3D graphics, films, modelling, printing, television and any technique capable of recording three-dimensional visual information or creating the illusion of depth in an image. At Agora Digital Art, we are on a mission to promote women artists who create with and in New Media because Digital Art induces deeper reflection on, and interpretation of, the world around us.

feeds.title: Outshaped
feeds.description: We create impressive shapes for 3D Art and Manufacturing projects. Using robots to cut out large-scale cores, molds, signs, props, displays, and just about anything else you can think of. At Outshaped, we find the best of both worlds to give you the engaging design you want while keeping it structurally sound and cost-effective.

feeds.title: The Art Squirrel » 3D
feeds.description: Read articles in the 3D category for The Art Squirrel digital art blog on topics such as digital sculpting, 3D software and related subjects. My name is Christine Garner. I'm an Illustrator / digital painter learning 3D skills. This blog was created when I decided to document some of my progress and discoveries from 2016 onward. The blog focuses on my continuing journey learning 3D and practising digital art skills.

feeds.title: Alex Lashko Blog
feeds.description: Alex Lashko is a digital artist specializing in modelling and texturing using 3D/2D graphics applications. His specialities are 3D Character/Hard Surface Modeling using Maya. High-Resolution details and texturing using ZBrush and Photoshop.

feeds.title: Francesco Saviano Blog
feeds.description: My name is Francesco Saviano. 3D Artist & Graphic Designer. Computer Graphics and Photography are my worlds. I love what I do and I'm always looking for new trends and inspirations for my creations.

feeds.title: Jose Villafranca Blog
feeds.description: Im a 3d artist from Honduras living in the UK. I enjoy every aspect of 3d but am mostly interested in character creation both organic and Hardsurface for videogames. constantly learning to expand my skillset.

feeds.title: Spoon's 3D Art
feeds.description: Spoon's 3D Art is a place to dump my 3D art. All transparent, all made by me.
